title: Log in and reach the dashboard
description: A user can log in with valid credentials and is taken to the main dashboard after authentication.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the form
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Create process, change Kanban status via drag-and-drop, and save deadline
description: Creates a new process, confirms it appears on the Kanban board, moves it to another status, edits the deadline in details, and verifies the updated deadline is shown.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to processes
Start creating a new process
Fill in the process number with PROC-1001
Select a tribunal value
Select an area value
Select a responsible person
Submit the process form
Drag the new process card to a different Kanban status column
Open the process details for PROC-1001
Fill a valid deadline date into the deadline field
Save the process changes
Verify the process details display the updated deadline

title: Add financial transaction, filter by date range, and export report
description: Records a new transaction, confirms it appears in the ledger, filters by a date range that includes it, and exports the filtered results to a PDF report.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to financial management
Start adding a new financial transaction
Select a transaction type
Fill 123.45 into the amount field
Fill a valid transaction date into the date field
Submit the transaction form
Set a date range filter that includes the created transaction date
Export the filtered transactions to a PDF report
Verify a PDF report preview or export confirmation is visible for the currently filtered results
